sources.quote: controlled by St. Clairsville, Ohio-based American Consolidated Natural Resources, has had more than 1,800 penalties assessed to operator Ohio County Coal Resources, Inc. by MSHA since the start of 2019.
sources.searcher_note: Pattern: violation counts since 2019 at two fatal mines (Marfork's Panther Eagle ~1,100 violations, 139 S&S; ACNR's Ohio County Mine 1,800+ penalties, 312 S&S). Raw counts, not per miner. Updated 2026-07-30. Page shows a subscription prompt but the text was retrieved.

sources.quote: The Panther Eagle Horse Creek Mine reportedly received 50 citations for Mine Safety and Health Administration (MSHA) health and safety standard violations in early 2026 alone.
sources.searcher_note: Trade-press follow-up on the same two fatal mines' citation histories; mine-level counts, no per-miner rate.
